tagline: An endless fall through a tunnel of light and colour, in the spirit of the Star Gate in 2001: A Space Odyssey, with music that never repeats.
overview:
Wormhole is not a game but an experience: you fall forever through a tunnel of light. Colours, patterns and shapes rush toward you and past you; every 150 units of tunnel brings a new palette and pattern, the tunnel's own shape slowly morphs between round, many-sided, petal-like and a slit-scan lens, and pulses of light race in at random. Nothing is asked of you except to look around with the mouse.

The music is part of the journey. Five pieces (Event Horizon, Glass Rain, Choir of Stars, Tide and Aurora) are re-composed with fresh seeds and keys as you go and crossfaded into each other, so the soundtrack, like the tunnel, never comes round again. Every launch draws a new seed (printed when it starts): the same seed gives the same journey.
story: No story, only the fall: you are drifting down an endless tunnel of light, as if falling through a wormhole or the Star Gate at the end of 2001: A Space Odyssey, with nowhere to arrive and nothing to do but look.
goal: There is no goal and no end: fall, look around, and listen.
rules: You never move on your own: the fall carries you. The mouse turns your view, so you can look ahead, to the side or behind.
The tunnel changes its colours and patterns every stretch, and its shape on its own slow clock.
The music is a journey of five pieces, re-composed and crossfaded as you go; it can be turned off in the pause menu or with N.
Each launch has its own seed; the same seed gives the same sky and music.

tips: Make it fullscreen (F) and turn the lights down.
Look backwards now and then: the colours you just passed streaming away are part of the show.
Write down a seed you like: launch with it again to repeat that journey.

prompt:
https://github.com/kevstermcgee/RedEngine

Create a hypnotic endless 2001 a space odyssey-esque wormhole with this game engine. 

Call it Wormhole

I want this to go on forever with unique patterns and color combinations. Different shapes and movements of waves of color splashing and roaring towards us as if we’re falling through a colorful vibrant wormhole forever. I don’t just want the same thing on loop, ensure there is endless variety.

There doesn’t have to be any actual gameplay, more of a simulation

Allow interaction in the sense you can look around as to fall/float through this. I want this to feel beautiful and moving. Please include fitting touching unique music throughout the experience.

Once complete publish to the Games website and attach your feedback to this engine’s project
